rationale: All three lines denied CO-16 with MOA N286 (missing/incomplete/invalid referring provider). The 837P party list shows billing, rendering, subscriber, and payer loops but no referring provider loop. Medicare Part B requires an ordering/referring NPI; its absence is a data defect, not a coverage dispute. Claim adjudicated (835 with CLP07 2625095686411); remedy is a new original — Part B does not accept frequency 7. DOS 2026-07-20; 1-year filing limit runs to 2027-07-20.
